tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background, the colour of cooked rice. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the map preview popup, form fields.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: filter chips at rest, skeleton loaders, the search field.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between reviews and list rows. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and icons on any surface token. 16:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, review dates, counts. 6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: sambal
tokens.usage: Brand red. The logo, the main button, the selected map pin. One sambal action per screen.

tokens.name: sambal-strong
tokens.usage: Text links and pressed state of sambal buttons. 6.7:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: on-sambal
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on sambal. 4.9:1 light, 6.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: padi
tokens.usage: Paddy-field green of Kedah. Halal tag, success messages, the focus ring.

tokens.name: padi-tint
tokens.usage: Background of halal and vegetarian tags; padi text sits on it at 5.5:1.

tokens.name: kunyit
tokens.usage: Turmeric yellow. Rating stars and the Hidden gem badge icon only. Icon contrast (3:1), never body text.

tokens.name: kunyit-tint
tokens.usage: Hidden gem badge background; ink text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, delete and report actions. Always paired with an icon and words, because it sits near sambal in hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: cat-warung
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for warung. White glyph on it, 5.4:1.

tokens.name: cat-mamak
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for mamak, the colour of teh tarik.

tokens.name: cat-kopitiam
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for kopitiam, after the old floor tiles.

tokens.name: cat-hawker
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for hawker stall.

tokens.name: cat-pasar-malam
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for night market (pasar malam).

tokens.name: cat-cafe
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for cafe, pandan green.

tokens.name: cat-other
tokens.usage: Map pin and chip for other.
